trello.name: Review, sign, and confirm AV for venue contract
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: End of next week. Get the convention center contract through legal review and signed. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall and two breakout rooms).

trello.name: Lock the speaker lineup
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: Two weeks. Send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If either declines, fill the third slot from the backup list of five names. Have the full lineup of nine speakers locked in two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: This week. Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract. The abstract is required for the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Draft and schedule three-wave email campaign
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: Drafts completed this month. Run the email campaign in three waves: 1) agenda announcement when the lineup locks, 2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, and 3) a final-week push. The first wave must go out the day the agenda is live.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots for website update
trello.desc: Owners: Bo (handoff) and Diego (landing page update). Deadline: Same day the lineup locks. Once the lineup locks, Bo must hand the speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego for the landing page update on the same day. The website needs the speaker pages live before the first wave of the email campaign.

trello.name: Review swag design proofs and place order
trello.desc: Owners: Camille (review/approve) and Diego (place order). Deadline: Camille reviews today, Diego places the order this week. Camille will review the design proofs located in the shared drive today. Once Camille approves, Diego will immediately place the order for 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers (approx. 9,200 with the rush buffer). Lead time is six weeks.
